prompt: Build a polished Three.js orbit-dodger game: move a spacecraft with arrow keys or WASD, dodge incoming asteroids, earn score over time, show health and game over, and restart with R. Include responsive rendering and an accessible controls panel.

Build a polished Three.js crystal maze: move with WASD or arrow keys, navigate walls with collision detection, collect five crystals, reach the exit to win, and restart with R. Include a readable HUD, responsive camera, and clear controls.

Build a polished Three.js island-hopper platform game: move with WASD, jump with Space, land on platforms with deterministic gravity and collision detection, collect coins, respawn after falling, and restart with R. Include a follow camera, HUD, and clear controls.
